items.title: Augustus – Open-source LLM Vulnerability Scanner With 210+ Attacks Across 28 LLM Providers
items.description: Augustus is a new open-source vulnerability scanner designed to secure Large Language Models (LLMs) against an evolving landscape of adversarial threats.
